PART I

Item 1. Business

Example Corp designs and sells widgets to industrial customers in Europe and North America.

The Company has two reportable segments: Industrial Widgets and Consumer Widgets.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

The Company depends on a single supplier in Taiwan for its main widget component. Any disruption at this supplier could materially affect production.

Changes in export controls could limit sales of advanced widgets to certain countries.

Item 7. Management’s Discussion and Analysis

Total net sales increased 8% to $12,345 million in fiscal 2024, driven by Industrial Widgets.

Operating income was $2,100 million.
